title: Correlated Gaussian measure
statement: For a real parameter $\rho$, let $\gamma$ be the probability measure on $\mathbb R^2$ obtained as the pushforward of the product of two independent standard Gaussian measures under the Gaussian correlation map with parameter $\rho$.
caveat: The snippet does not define the Gaussian correlation map, so its precise formula cannot be stated from the supplied formal statement.
